h: Linda Ejiofor wins Best Supporting Actress at 2026 AMAA
p: Nollywood actress Linda Ejiofor won Best Actress in a Supporting Role at the 2026 Africa Movie Academy Awards for her role in The Herd. Her husband and colleagues have flooded her page with congratulations.
body: Nollywood actress Ihuoma Linda Ejiofor has won the award for Best Actress in a Supporting Role at the 2026 Africa Movie Academy Awards (AMAA).
The ceremony took place on Sunday, 15 November 2026, and Ejiofor was honoured for her performance in the film The Herd.

After the announcement, her husband and many of her colleagues in the film industry went to the comment section of her social media page to congratulate her, and fans joined in with messages of praise and encouragement.
